items.name: components/theme-toggle
items.title: Theme Toggle
items.description: Use when an app needs a controlled three-way theme switch (system, light, dark) with accessible icon buttons.

items.name: components/locale-switcher
items.title: Locale Switcher
items.description: Use when an app needs a controlled language dropdown with flag icons that closes after a pick.

items.name: components/dropzone
items.title: Dropzone
items.description: Use when a form needs file upload by drag and drop or click: keyboard-openable, shows accepted types and sizes, and reports rejected files through an onError callback you render as text. Vendored from Kibo UI (shadcnblocks/kibo, MIT).
